diffs.diff: cell temperature (degC): offset 0 vs datasheet reading -273.15
diffs.evidence: Datasheet register table: '0x08 Cell Temperature R 0x0000 to 0xFFFF, 0.1K (0.0°C = 0x0AAC), Displays Cell Temperature, default 0x0BA6 (25°C); W 0x09E4 to 0x0D04 (I2C mode)'. So degC = raw*0.1 - 273.2, matching the second reading (scale 0.1, offset -273.15 within rounding). The model's driver already implements exactly this: temperature() returns (raw - 0x0AAC)/10 and set_temperature() writes celsius*10 + 0x0AAC clamped to 0x09E4..0x0D04; SKILL.md documents '0x08 cell temperature (0.1 K, 0x0AAC = 0 °C)'. The 'offset 0' is the gate pairing the temperature conversion with one of the sim's 0-offset measures (cell voltage / RSOC / ITE); the sim does not model cell temperature as a measured field (0x08 is a fixed register 2982 = 25.0 °C, consistent with the formula).
